fields.text: Aliyah was amazing! Her knowledge about marine life is incredible and she made our experience both fun and educational. Highly recommend!

John's tour of the tea plantation was fascinating from start to finish. He clearly loves this island's history and it shows — every stop had a story behind it. One of the best guided tours we've done anywhere.
The snorkelling was calm and beautiful, and the guide pointed out turtles and fish I would never have noticed. Very patient with beginners.
The walk through Port Louis felt like a story, not a lecture. I loved the little details about the buildings and the markets.
The spice garden was a treat for the senses, and the cooking session was great fun. We left with recipes we have already tried at home.
Warm, friendly and full of family stories about tea. The tasting was the highlight of our trip.
A steady pace and clear safety advice made the hike enjoyable even for a beginner. The views at the top were worth the early start.
Kevin knows the trails very well and found us a quiet waterfall viewpoint. Great photo stops along the way.
